source.snippet: I'm trying to adjust the layout of my Squarespace Request a Quote form... I need the Requirement Details textarea to span both columns, and I need the Upload Requirements field to sit directly below it... I've been using AI to create this quote form and it looks great but none of the 5 AI platforms can figure out how to fix this. I have a feeling th[at it's a Squarespace-specific CSS limitation].

problem_statement: Small business owners using no-code website builders like Squarespace cannot resolve platform-specific CSS and form layout issues even after trying multiple general-purpose AI tools, leaving their lead-capture forms broken and costing them potential revenue.
target_segment: Small business owners and freelancers managing their own Squarespace (or similar no-code platform) websites without a dedicated developer
notes: Buyer signal: user is a paying Squarespace customer whose revenue-generating quote form is broken. Tried 5 different AI platforms and failed — indicates genuine unmet need for platform-specific no-code fix services or specialized tools. Single data point but representative of a broad segment of non-technical business owners stuck on no-code platform quirks.
